title: Affirmative agreement with singular subjects
summary: Match minä, sinä, and hän with olen, olet, and on.
objectives: Match minä, sinä, and hän with olen, olet, and on.
Apply the pattern using the supporting forms shown.

sections.title: Read the subject before choosing
paragraphs: Match minä, sinä, and hän with olen, olet, and on.
The English word “are” does not identify the Finnish person. Choose the form from the subject.

commonMistakes: Keep the person of the subject when choosing the verb.

practiceExercises.prompt: Optional practice: Complete “I am on time now.” Minä ____ ajoissa nyt.
practiceExercises.explanation: Minä takes olen, the matching present-tense form of olla.

optionFeedback.olen: Correct. Minä takes olen, the matching present-tense form of olla.
optionFeedback.olet: “olet” does not fit this subject or construction. Minä takes olen, the matching present-tense form of olla.
optionFeedback.on: “on” does not fit this subject or construction. Minä takes olen, the matching present-tense form of olla.
